notes: Arc Publishing: one daily sitemap per date (robots.txt lists only breakingnews feeds; found via /arc/outboundfeeds/sitemap-index/), 107-229 <loc>/day over the whole window, every lastmod = that day; canonical URLs are /YYYY/MM/DD/slug/ (the same file also lists /print/YYYY/MM/DD/slug/ twins, excluded by the regex), ~75-140 of the returned URLs carry the day's own date in the path and the rest are older items updated that day, so filter on the path date downstream; no pagination (page=2 / /2/ ignored or 404).
